rootCause: A declaration or path mention is mistaken for a reachable test invocation; population stops at one runner/package.
principle: Every useful regression contract has a real invocation at its required channel; exceptions name environment and ownership.
detectorPlan: Extend existing P38/P41 population/command resolvers and reconcile with in-flight TAK P53 delivery-discovery. Enumerate supported package, Node and Python carriers; explicit known command grammar refuses ambiguous wiring. No new competing registry. Include nonstandard test-*.sh manual regressions with explicit disposition.
legitimateCounterexamples: Historical fault fixtures
External native-corpus validators
Explicit local-only mutation and opt-in AIF live probe
Helper-delegated Python tests reached through Vitest
Conditional non-Linux arms
prospectiveInvocation: Existing principles at pre-push and required CI; local sweep coverage; TAKE9 conformance on detector change.
independentConformanceBoundary: Frozen executable vs echo/comment/noninvoked script pairs; missing whole package or language; wrong import/root and detector disabled must fail through actual future carrier. External permissions/timeouts classify as infrastructure, not caught faults.
costControl: Fast source/native metadata reconciliation normally; bounded actual fault only on changed detector/runner; no complete mutation on unrelated docs.
stage: S2 proposal; not implemented or certified by S1

rootCause: A broad availability/degrade branch swallows a real checker rejection.
principle: A command that ran and rejected must propagate failure; unavailable tools have a separate explicit state.
detectorPlan: Extend existing local-sweep fixtures using the real actionlint row; integrate TAK Q4/P52 subprocess-status conformance rather than a standalone ignored-exit platform.
legitimateCounterexamples: Intentionally advisory absent-tool branch with explicit UNVERIFIED
Expected nonzero negative fixture followed by exact diagnostic assertion
Optional collection failure recorded separately from quality gate
prospectiveInvocation: Actual sweep gate-table row and inherited required actionlint CI.
independentConformanceBoundary: Pinned actionlint valid/invalid workflow/restored; stub exit0/1/42 to assert propagation; wrapper bypass must fail held conformance.
costControl: Milliseconds synthetic controls plus one actual tool fixture on related changes; existing runner reused.
stage: S2 proposal; not implemented or certified by S1

rootCause: A metatest recomputes the production predicate and never calls production.
principle: Expected outcomes stay fixed while tests execute the actual checker and entrypoint.
detectorPlan: Reuse/extract existing discipline body checker and move positive/adverse fixtures onto it. Extend TAK Q3/51 finite corpus and executable counterfactual layer. The existing husky-presence manual simulator has the same source-supported detached-predicate pattern and needs disposable hooks before routing.
legitimateCounterexamples: Intentional byte/source parity test with separately named behavior witness
Fixed schema or snapshot contract
Helper assertions and delegated child tests
prospectiveInvocation: Existing named PR-body job plus owned deterministic suite; independent TAK verification for checker/fixture changes.
independentConformanceBoundary: Production success stub passes formerly-invalid body, but held conformance must fail; valid/skip/main cases retained; no deriving expected verdict from checker.
costControl: Consolidate two detached jobs after replacement; reuse Bash/Node runner. No new semantic prose judge.
stage: S2 proposal; not implemented or certified by S1

rootCause: Declared required status is not registered in live enforcement, while an unreadable admin endpoint green-warns.
principle: A prevention claim identifies an actually enforced status and event, not a source declaration.
detectorPlan: Read ordinary branch metadata and supported ruleset details with explicit tri-state. Preserve required-context declaration consistency. Administrative registration is a separately owned effect; source-only detector improves visibility but does not itself register anything.
legitimateCounterexamples: Unprotected fork with intentionally different owner policy
Main promotion has its own required contexts
Public branch metadata unavailable: explicit unknown, never registered-pass
prospectiveInvocation: Existing workflow-integrity observation, existing P37 declarations, actual owner verification after authorized registration.
independentConformanceBoundary: Fixtures readable complete/missing, unreadable, active-but-uninspected rulesets; held live snapshot and exact context names. Verify actual workflow-token endpoint access before relying on it.
costControl: One bounded read-only API call when policy/CI changes. No long-lived admin PAT added solely for audit.
stage: S2 proposal; not implemented or certified by S1

rootCause: Same subject/config/oracle is rerun after an unrelated consumer install and labelled as consumer coverage.
principle: Keep each unique subject×environment×event×timing witness; remove exact zero-marginal repetitions only against survivors.
detectorPlan: Extend existing cold review-sidecar Test-Quality Review with same subject/config/environment/event/timing witness analysis and explicit survivor; require a structured finding or no-material-finding result and consumed disposition in the existing acceptance/fidelity path. Details in preventionProposal. No permanent duplication parser, profiler or optimization service.
legitimateCounterexamples: Same suite on Windows vs Linux
Root vs core config difference
Installed/tarball subject vs source
Earlier local check vs before-merge CI
prospectiveInvocation: Existing portable cold review at PR handoff; existing head-bound fidelity acceptance plus required fidelity-verdict-in-pr-body for deterministic report binding. Surviving tests are protection witnesses, not the recurrence detector.
independentConformanceBoundary: Remove both designated repetitions jointly while retaining root224cases and consumer install failures; root/source mutation still caught.
costControl: Observed6/7/6step-seconds only; no fabricated setup or compute savings. Add one focused rubric to the already required cold review, no extra seat by default; reuse captured history. On relevant scheduling edits, at most two same-source prior successful runs for initial judgment; absent history is explicit unknown/owner disposition. Full reruns only if a specific unresolved decision needs them. Schema/diff checks are bounded to changed paths and report; do not scan all cases or call an LLM in CI.
stage: S2 proposal; not implemented or certified by S1

preventionProposal.triggerProposal: At existing cold PR review, inspect exact base/head diff for changes to .github/workflows/**, .husky/**, package.json/workspace package.json test/check scripts, Makefile, scripts/run-local-ci-sweep.sh, scripts/run-install-sh-suite.sh, packages/core/hooks/pre-push.ts, or test/probe implementations reached by edited carriers. Include rename/deletion and unknown diff as review-required. Unrelated docs-only diff needs no cost collection. Reuse the current changed-path/merge-base pattern in pr-body-prior-art-bin.ts for a bounded trigger passed to the existing fidelity checker; never trust an author-supplied applicable=false flag.

fields: retained witnesses or reason none removable

preventionProposal.consumptionProposal: The existing controller/harvest cold-review stage consumes each material finding before fidelity: fixed requires delta evidence, retained requires recorded counterexample/benefit; unresolved material or unaccepted deferral blocks GO. Extend the existing fidelity checker/bin to require the head-bound scoped review record and a disposition per reported RC5/RC6 finding on triggered diffs, rejecting missing/stale/duplicate records and unresolved material findings. An owner-accepted deferral must identify the named authority and evidence, not erase the finding. Reuse accepted PR2146 sidecar-card/consumer contract if landed by S2. CI validates binding/completeness only; it cannot certify reviewer judgment or economic optimality.
invocationAndDisablementProposal: Held diff adding a second identical root auditor after an install must activate review; deleting/changing script membership also activates. An unrelated prose-only diff does not demand history or a new review seat.

Drive actual existing fidelity CLI with changed-path inputs and missing, stale-head, unresolved, duplicate and legitimately disposed records; require correct nonzero/zero statuses. Repeat with edited PR body event fixture; skip/unregistered new context must not substitute for the observed required context.

Disable trigger wiring or remove required review section in scratch: independently held carrier conformance must fail. Disable checker/return success: independent held negative fixture must fail. A test calling only an internal parser is insufficient.

Use bounded held cold-review cases (exact duplicate, unique environment, imbalanced equivalent shards, justified slow unique test); require observed cold report and consumed disposition, not a canned checker claiming semantic economics detection. Reconcile with TAK accepted review conformance; no new paid-LLM CI job.
preventionProposal.boundedClaim: Future review channel surfaces and disposes materially redundant/imbalanced changed work; mechanical checks only enforce that this scoped review/disposition reached acceptance. Neither perfect detection, automatic optimality, nor all-history duplication coverage is claimed. No S1 implementation.

rootCause: Resource cleanup is coupled to an ordinary case selected by the user and assertions precede cleanup.
principle: Fixture lifecycle must close resources regardless of test selection or assertion outcome.
detectorPlan: Use native test teardown/finally with existing aftermath oracle; add bounded filtered invocation regression in current test harness. Incorporate into TAK runner-soundness conformance only where supported.
legitimateCounterexamples: A final assertion aggregating whole-run effects is useful
A deliberately live external process with explicit owner/cancellation contract
prospectiveInvocation: Node --test normal/filtered invocation, then D07 durable carrier.
independentConformanceBoundary: No-selected-case and selected-case finish; forced aftermath failure still closes; prohibition counters preserved; independent watchdog distinguishes hang from semantic red.
costControl: Subsecond normal control; short bounded timeout only on changed lifecycle/runner. No global full-suite setup.
stage: S2 proposal; not implemented or certified by S1
